svg.title: Lifecycle worker: renewal, retries and expiry
svg.desc: Flowchart of the 15-minute lifecycle job: due renewals, recurring payment, webhook activation with period extension, retries, and six more expiry, rollback and notice jobs.

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Renewal is expanded below; six more expiry, rollback and notice jobs run in the same tick.
absolute: T+24 h, then T+72 h
SAME TICK · SIX MORE INDEPENDENT JOBS (errors joined, one failure does not stop the rest)
expired immediately · no grace, no retry
expired at period end, not before
rollback to revert_* if still on applied_offer_id
